### Diagnostic information

If possible, save the file while the problem is happening, before using **Reset Audio**. If you have already reset the audio, save the information that remains.

Choose **Save Diagnostic Information…** from **Help** on desktop, **Settings** on the web, or **⋮** at the top right on mobile. Review the file before attaching it here. It includes selected audio device names, and some names or paths may remain. You can edit the saved file first. If your version or browser extension has no diagnostic menu, submit the report without a file.
